extras: Local boards operate fully offline without an account or telemetry. Optional Sync Deck integration provides cross-device sync, shared vaults, and live presence.
intentEvidence: It has since evolved into a substantially expanded implementation with a broader product direction, independent customization, and new workflows beyond the original plugin.
problem: Users need a visual, board-based way to manage tasks and workflows without losing the searchability and portability of standard Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: This project originally used ismailivanov/task-deck as its base.

summary: Kanux provides a Trello-style Kanban and table view for organizing tasks, allowing cards to remain as searchable Markdown notes.
